tier1_postgresql.purpose: real multi-connection transactional acceptance, owner-authority, ambiguity, owner-derived history currentness, physical PITR and surviving-authority recovery evidence

tier2_timescale.purpose: candidate tenant isolation, background jobs, fresh-cluster restore, authenticated relocation checkpoint/freeze and bounded capacity falsification

classification_basis.final_package_gate_requirement: The exact final package HEAD, including reviewer documentation, must independently rerun both gates before review or acceptance.
classification_basis.note: The executable anchor proves owner-controlled source/poll authority; owner-derived history finality/currentness; surviving external authenticated PITR recovery grants; genuine fresh-cluster Timescale reconstruction; lock-before-F source fencing; target-owned authenticated sealed checkpoints; canonical-payload equivalence; no uncheckpointed pre-activation target history; and seal-vs-DML serialization.

codex_material_findings_closed_by_curren: conflicting canonical observation content under stable identity must reject
active source and poll authority must be resolved from owner-controlled state in the transaction
relocation source placement must be locked before deriving F
max(target)=F cannot prove complete target coverage
history completeness requires contiguous coverage from supported_history_floor
target activation must bind to current actual target state
relocation fingerprint must include immutable canonical payload
PITR admission must consume authenticated surviving (R,F] evidence rather than a locally self-minted receipt
history finality/currentness must be derived from durable owner/provider authority rather than worker-supplied timestamps
target rows above F before activation must be rejected or included in checkpoint authority
native_assurance_panorama_extensions: durable live poll claim required for current-state candidacy
reconciliation snapshot currentness required in addition to interval geometry
seal serializes against target DML before measuring checkpoint set
freeze protects cross-tenant identity and the full sealed pre-activation target state
activated target history through F remains immutable while only post-F append is eligible
projection writer cannot read attestation key or disable target freeze
Timescale LOGIN automation owner is explicitly a cross-tenant privileged infrastructure principal; PASSWORD NULL is not NOLOGIN or production admission proof

late_history_evidence.worker: history_reconcile_worker NOLOGIN with EXECUTE only on sweep/finalize
late_history_evidence.sweep_authority: worker supplies only window plus expected authority generation; actual provider snapshot is read and locked from provider_authority
late_history_evidence.finalization_authority: try_finalize accepts no caller finality/currentness timestamps; it reads and locks owner provider_authority
late_history_evidence.stale_worker: rejected when expected generation differs from durable current authority
late_history_evidence.coverage_semantics: only overlapping/touching runs whose durable provider_snapshot_at satisfies owner-required currentness form continuous coverage
late_history_evidence.owner_currentness_negative: generation-2 runs at snapshot 12:15 cannot satisfy generation-3 owner requirement 12:16; a fresh generation-3 covering sweep is required
late_history_evidence.unrecoverable_retention_loss: explicit durable gap; never false complete

recovery_evidence.restore_boundary: physical PostgreSQL PITR to committed R
recovery_evidence.surviving_authority: separate external control PostgreSQL not included in source backup/restore
recovery_evidence.grant_authentication: HMAC-SHA-256 with random key stored only in surviving external authority
recovery_evidence.successful_admission: requires reconciled local R state plus fresh successful verification of the surviving external authenticated grant

relocation_evidence.source_fence_derivation: placement authority locked before F is derived
relocation_evidence.source_inflight_acceptance_race: acceptance holding placement lock commits before fence and is included in F
relocation_evidence.canonical_payload_fingerprint: SHA-256 over ordered accepted_ordinal, observation_id, metric_definition_id, normalized UTC observed_at and normalized numeric_value for the evidence observation profile
relocation_evidence.projection_writer: ts_automation_owner with projection DML but without checkpoint/key ownership or freeze-disable authority
relocation_evidence.checkpoint_attestation: domain-separated HMAC-SHA-256 over target-owned checkpoint facts
relocation_evidence.preseal_future_row: any target row accepted_ordinal > F makes sealing fail and leaves control phase open
relocation_evidence.sealed_phase: all target-history DML for the relocating tenant is rejected; therefore no >F row can enter during seal-to-activation
relocation_evidence.activated_phase: existing history is immutable; INSERT is eligible only above the relocation fence
relocation_evidence.seal_dml_serialization: target DML takes target_control shared authority; seal takes exclusive authority before future-row check and digest

crypto_evidence_boundary.checkpoint_sha256_and_hmac_sha256: bounded evidence mechanisms; not production KMS/HSM/secret topology selection
crypto_evidence_boundary.recovery_grant_hmac_sha256: bounded evidence mechanism proving restored authority cannot derive its own recovery grant from restored state
crypto_evidence_boundary.production_requirement: accepted implementation must preserve equivalent or stronger independently trustworthy checkpoint and recovery-grant authority under the separately accepted security/platform key-management architecture

privileged_automation_boundary.production_requirement: database connection/authentication admission, pg_hba/socket/network exposure and role-membership policy must prevent tenant/application principals from authenticating as or assuming ts_automation_owner

required_security_shape: no direct tenant-facing privilege on shared raw history, continuous aggregate or internal materialization
tenant binding outside caller-writable SQL state
separate NOLOGIN mediation/checkpoint owner and least-privilege LOGIN automation owner
LOGIN automation owner is explicitly cross-tenant privileged infrastructure
production connection/authentication topology excludes tenant/application use of automation owner
tenant-facing/runtime roles have no owner membership, CREATEROLE, SUPERUSER or BYPASSRLS
projection writer cannot read target attestation key or disable target freeze
backup/restore role topology is reconstructed in a genuinely fresh cluster
isolation attacks repeat after jobs, fresh-cluster restore and restored-job execution

bounded_capacity_observation.interpretation: Mechanism-level bounded fitness evidence only. Production SLOs, retention, cardinality, sizing, cost and topology remain OPEN-REL-020 C3.

decision_recommendation.tier1: accept PostgreSQL Tier 1 mechanism only with immutable canonical observation content, owner-controlled source/poll authority, durable live poll claims, owner-derived provider finality/currentness, contiguous reconciliation, authenticated surviving recovery grants after PITR, lock-before-F relocation fencing and verification of target-owned sealed canonical-payload checkpoints
decision_recommendation.tier2: accept TimescaleDB historical projection only under the mediated shared-history profile, privileged automation-owner admission boundary, genuine fresh-cluster role reconstruction, complete target checkpoint equivalence, rejection of any uncheckpointed target data before activation, and immutable pre-F target history after cutover
rejected_assumptions: caller or worker supplied timestamps are not provider finality/currentness authority
a locally recreated post-R receipt is not surviving (R,F] recovery authority
target count/digest/max supplied by caller are not current target authority
identity-only digests are not canonical payload equivalence
target rows above F may not exist invisibly before activation
PASSWORD NULL on a LOGIN role is not NOLOGIN or production connection-admission proof
same-cluster restore is not fresh role-topology recovery evidence
max(reconciliation window_to) is not contiguous history completeness
decision_recommendation.reversibility: Tier 2 remains behind the telemetry projection seam; replacement must preserve canonical observation identity/payload, idempotent projection, owner-derived currentness, externally surviving recovery authority, target checkpoint/freeze semantics, privileged-infrastructure boundaries, tenant isolation and relocation/recovery semantics
